en: A hand-colored historical postcard view of a broad cobblestone square lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand around a small market stall in the center. The main corner building has shop signs on the ground floor, including German text, and the overall scene depicts an urban market square in a European town. The sky is softly tinted in pastel tones, typical of colored lithographic postcards.
